spanish: Y su guarda: el arca y la mesa y la menorá y los altares y utensilios del santo con que servirán en ellos, y el masaj, y todo su servicio.

findings.issue: Common noun left untranslated as the lemma transliteration menorá.
Common noun left untranslated as the lemma transliteration masaj.
The relative plus one prepositional phrase is rendered as both con que and en ellos, so the preposition and 3mp suffix are said twice.
del santo can be read as a holy person; the token is a common noun, not a person.

notes: Possessive su matches the 3mp and 3ms suffixes; list conjunctions and numbers match.
